scope.description: Actual Pi 5 direct VCM processing of the existing historical exposed holdout. Not the separate 642-recording producer regression set, a fresh blind test, or live microphone acceptance.
scope.workload: SpeakerUI stayed running in awaiting_microphone; no CPU governor/clock changes. Runs were sequential, not quiesced.
scope.accuracy_unit: First pass per original recording. Three timing passes per configuration; no denominator inflation.
scope.memory_scope: Whole benchmark Python-process lifetime peak RSS, including libraries and result storage, not model-only RAM.

inputs.acquisition: Verified 14.55 MB source downloaded before repeat 01; both measurement rounds were offline. No audio or model files are included in this receipt.

reference_contract.selection_rule: Keep original scoring eligibility and include the exact typed expected command (or null UNKNOWN) only if it belongs to both immutable inventories. Additional diagnostic only; full 194-reference scores remain unchanged.

metrics.model_scope: Direct VCM session only; wake/VAD, owner sessions, UI and action providers are excluded.

metrics.timing_components: after_frontend includes engine inference, finite decision and wrapper overhead; no unmeasured model/decision split is invented.
metrics.resource_scope: Whole benchmark Python process, including libraries, result storage and runtime; lifetime RSS peak is not model-only memory.
metrics.thread_scope: --threads controls the inference engine; unset frontend BLAS variables mean library defaults.

source.note: The local application includes the user-authorized native CPU adapter. Base commit plus exact source hashes identify it; this publication does not push application source or claim a clean-base-commit MNN reproduction.

caveats: Historical full-set vocabulary differs: baseline A cannot express 27 scored expected commands. Never present 79.90% and 93.30% as a same-vocabulary ranking.
The shared 167-reference comparison includes 11 negatives; false accepts are model-only and are not operational false-action rates.
These 11 negatives are a different population from the published baseline-A 5/19 human task negatives. Do not pool them.
The older epoch44 model has a different parameter count, inventory and original rejection policy; it is not the matched-size DEV control.
Recorded processing time excludes speech/capture, file decoding, wake/VAD/owner/endpoint waiting, UI IPC, providers and TTS.
Two runs show host/workload timing variation. Do not claim universal MNN acceleration, live latency, or qualification.
